versions.content: Invocation of LSduR_LinIfTriggerTransmit in master nodes Status: DRAFT The LIN Interface shall call the function LSduR_LinIfTriggerTransmit with the PduInfoPtr pointer containing data buffer (SduDataPtr) and buffer length (Sdu- Length) to get the data part of the frame (data in the LIN frame response) when a schedule entry for a frame transmission is due.
